persona: Mid-level general insurance reserving analyst with IAI exam progress
resumeText:
Ananya Iyer | Mumbai | ananya.iyer@example.com

SUMMARY
Actuarial analyst with 5 years in general insurance reserving and life experience studies.

EXPERIENCE
Actuarial Analyst, Konkan Re Analytics, Mumbai (2022 - present)
- Run quarterly claims reserving using chain ladder and Bornhuetter-Ferguson methods for motor and health portfolios.
- Estimate IBNR reserves and prepare reserving exhibits for the appointed actuary.
- Built Excel VBA macros to automate loss triangle preparation.
- Pull claims and premium data with SQL queries from the data warehouse.
- Wrote R scripts to fit claim severity distributions and test goodness of fit.

Actuarial Trainee, Marine Drive Consulting Actuaries, Mumbai (2021 - 2022)
- Supported lapse and mortality experience studies for a life insurer client.
- Prepared Excel summaries of claims data for client reports.

EXAMS
IAI CS1, CM1 and CB1 cleared; IFoA CS2 cleared

SKILLS
Excel, VBA, SQL, R, IFRS 17

EDUCATION
BSc Statistics, University of Mumbai, 2021
